question: on the two corpora script/m14/differential.ts draws markdown from, which of the four types the analyzer emits can a 60-file rotating draw ever place in the COMPARED set, given the allowlist at :23392 is ["contains","uses"]?

population.admission: every tracked .md/.markdown under scala3 and kubernetes — the two corpora named at script/m14/differential.ts:533 and :640
population.method: upper bound on any 60-file draw: a type with 0 edges here has 0 in every draw

oracleTruth.note: the oracle derives all four. That is necessary but NOT sufficient: the allowlist is what puts a kind in the compared set.

derivationFindings.why: measured NOT silent: the analyzer emits rows and the oracle derives truth, but the allowlist drops the analyzer side, so kubernetes reads 770 references rows as MISSING (logs/differential.log)
measured silent on these corpora: the analyzer emits rows here but the compared set excludes them, so a draw containing one would show unexplained/missing asymmetry rather than agreement

verdict: the DERIVATION count this lane publishes is 0 and the two published reasons for it are both wrong. The real position: the analyzer emits 4 types, the oracle derives 4, the allowlist compares 2, so references and imports are DERIVATION findings (2, not 0) and references has a MEASURED consequence already in the log — 770 MISSING on kubernetes. The fix is one array literal at script/m14/differential.ts:23392, a shared file, so it is reported not edited.
